description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named UserController, responsible for managing user-related operations in an admin web interface. It handles listing users, creating/editing users, changing passwords, reset password functionalities using security questions, and user deletion. The class uses various services such as UserService, GroupService, EmailService, etc., to perform backend operations and supports security roles and annotations for access control.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing user administration functions including listing, creating, editing, password management, and user deletion, with security role annotations and email notifications.

methods.name: displayUsers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list users, sets up menu and renders user list view.

methods.name: pageUsers
methods.description: Handles POST batch request to fetch paged user data for admin UI, returns JSON.

methods.name: displayChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the change password form for the current user.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes password change requests, validating current and new password, updates user, shows success or errors.

methods.name: displayUserCreate
methods.description: Displays the form to create a new user.

methods.name: displayUserEdit
methods.description: Loads user data for editing based on user ID and displays the edit form.

methods.name: displayUser
methods.description: Common method to prepare user data and auxiliary objects for user create/edit views.

methods.name: populateUserObjects
methods.description: Populates model with security questions, groups, stores, and languages for user forms.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Handles save/update of user profile, including validation, security, email notification on new user creation.

methods.name: checkUserCode
methods.description: Checks whether a username code already exists, returns JSON response.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user specified by ID, with authorization checks, returns JSON status.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu state for UI rendering.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset, returning security questions for verification.

methods.name: resetPasswordSecurityQtn
methods.description: Verifies security answers, resets password, and sends email notification.
